claims.value: General-purpose multimodal model accepting text, image, and audio inputs to generate text outputs, intended for agentic systems, coding, chatbots, and multilingual use.
claims.evidence: Inkling is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text, image and audio inputs and generates text outputs.
Inkling accepts text input in UTF-8 encoding, image input in any pixel-based format ... and audio input in WAV format sampled at 16kHz
A 66-layer decoder-only transformer with a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward backbone: each token is routed to 6 of 256 experts, plus 2 shared experts active on every token.
The model is natively multimodal — images and video are encoded via a hierarchical patch encoder, and audio via discrete token encoding
